content:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: auth failures for tenant=acme-corp in private VPC (dc-eu-1). Spike of 401/500 on inference endpoints. Affected: dedicated pool acme-dedicated-1. Paging @priyaa.oncall :rotating_light:

priyaa.oncall: on it. pulling logs and checking recent config changes. any customer ops notes? @leah-cs

leah-cs: Acme reported errors ~09:02 their time. They mentioned recent key rotation on their IdP yesterday. They asked if our side needs cert refresh.

sarah.ops: seeing a cascade from auth-service -> token-introspect: TLS handshake failures to idp.acme.internal: TLS alert (bad certificate). Many introspect requests hitting 502 from our side.

alex.sec: quick hypothesis: their introspection endpoint is protected by mTLS; their client cert (used by our control-plane to authenticate) expired at 2024-07-06T00:00Z per rotation email. Did we ingest the new cert?

priyaa.oncall: checking secret for acme-proxy-cert in vpc-secrets: `kubectl -n private-control get secret acme-proxy-cert -o yaml`

sarah.ops: log snippet: ```
2024-07-08T09:05:12Z auth-service ERROR introspect.go:87 "tls: failed to verify certificate" remote="idp.acme.internal:443" tenant=acme-corp
2024-07-08T09:05:12Z auth-service WARN token-cache.go:45 "introspection failed, returning 500" tenant=acme-corp
```

tom.support: customer says their IdP rotated keys yesterday and sent rotation notice. They think they uploaded the new cert to our portal but not sure. Leah, can you confirm upload?

leah-cs: I can see a submitted cert in the ticket but status=staged. Looks like it never promoted to active. I did not finish the final step because of a permissions error.

priyaa.oncall: ok mitigation plan: (1) work-around to restore auth by routing acme-corp auth calls to fallback introspection endpoint in our control-plane cluster that uses no mTLS (limited, logged), (2) finish cert activation in secrets so mTLS works end-to-end, (3) ask Acme SRE to confirm their server accepted our new cert. Step 1 is fast — do we have a safe toggle? @sarah.ops

sarah.ops: we have a feature-flagged route in private-control: `auth.introspection.override_map` for tenant overrides. can flip for single tenant. command: ```
kubectl -n private-control patch configmap auth-config --type json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/override_map/acme-corp","value":{"endpoint":"https://introspect-fallback.internal","mode":"no-mtls"}}]'
```
will need quick deploy reload (rolling restart of auth-service).

deploy-bot: deploy requested by priyaa.oncall: auth-config patch -> queued on private-control cluster. CI checks pass.

priyaa.oncall: i'll approve. rolling restart then monitor.

sarah.ops: rolling restart started. ```kubectl -n private-control rollout restart deployment/auth-service```

(3m) deploy-bot: rollout status: 3/3 pods updated, ready.

sarah.ops: pinging logs... auth-service starting to use `introspect-fallback.internal` for tenant=acme-corp. Errors drop from ~350/min to <5/min.

leah-cs: told Acme SRE about temporary config change and asked them to finish cert activation on our portal and confirm when done. They acknowledged and will check right away.

alex.sec: temporary no-mtls introspection increases risk surface. limit this to acme-corp only, full audit logging enabled, and set TTL 30m for the override. Also coordinate account team for post-mortem and compliance note.

priyaa.oncall: added TTL in config: `override_map.acme-corp.ttl=1800` and enabled audit logging `auth.audit.override=true`

(12m) leah-cs: Acme SRE confirms they promoted the cert; they can also confirm successful TLS handshake from our IPs if you need.

sarah.ops: re-seeding secrets now: `kubectl -n private-control apply -f acme-proxy-cert-active.yaml` then restart single pod sidecar for secret refresh.

(16m) deploy-bot: secret update applied -> sidecar restarted on auth-service-1.

sarah.ops: handshake to idp.acme.internal succeeded: `Handshake complete, verified peer certificate CN=acme-introspect` auth-service logs show introspection success for acme-corp. Reverting override now.

priyaa.oncall: removing override: patch configmap remove path `/override_map/acme-corp`. rolling restart again.

deploy-bot: rollout completed.

sarah.ops: error rate returned to baseline. Confirming with customer: Leah?

leah-cs: Acme says their calls are green. They saw a small blip ~09:05-09:20 then recovered. They asked for a summary and to confirm this won't happen after next rotation.

priyaa.oncall: summary for ticket: root cause = staged customer cert not promoted in our secrets, causing mTLS handshake failure after their IdP rotation. Impact = auth failures for acme-corp in private VPC -> 5xx on inference calls ~15min. Mitigation = short-lived override to fallback introspection, secret promotion, pod restart, revert override. Timeline included.

alex.sec: post-incident actions: (1) add validation step to secrets-promote flow to prevent 'staged' state without final activation, (2) alerting rule for mTLS handshake failures per-tenant, (3) runbook update with one-click steps for override and TTL.

priyaa.oncall: assigning JIRA to eng-oncall: ENG-4281 for runbook and alerting; ENG-4282 for secrets workflow fix. Also follow-up with account team to add explicit cert rotation checklist for Acme.

tom.support: adding summary to customer ticket and linking incident. sending a calendar invite for a short post-mortem with Acme and our CS/SRE/Platform folks.

leah-cs: customer asked for evidence that we rolled back the override and that full mTLS is in place; attaching logs and timestamps in the ticket.

priyaa.oncall: marking incident resolved for paging. leaving thread open for post-mortem notes. great job team :clap:
